# Teliolabs Communications (Teliolabs Communication Private Limited.)

Teliolabs Communications is a IT Services and IT Consulting company. Teliolabs provides end-to-end technology solutions to simplify human lives and accelerate digital transformation using a lean strategy and cutting-edge technologies. Teliolabs Communications employs 140 people (+10.6% YoY, +19 people), founded in 2020. Headquartered in South San Francisco, California, United States, with presence in United Kingdom. Its workforce is distributed across India, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates, and United States.

## About

At Teliolabs, we accelerate IT and digital transformation through cutting-edge AI-driven solutions. As a 𝐠𝐥𝐨𝐛𝐚𝐥 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐟𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐢𝐜𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐞𝐜𝐡 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐩𝐚𝐧𝐲, we specialize in 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐠𝐲, 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐮𝐥𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠, 𝐝𝐢𝐠𝐢𝐭𝐚𝐥 𝐬𝐨𝐥𝐮𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬, 𝐭𝐞𝐜𝐡𝐧𝐨𝐥𝐨𝐠𝐲, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬, empowering businesses across industries.

With a strong presence in the 𝐔𝐊, 𝐔𝐒, 𝐈𝐧𝐝𝐢𝐚, 𝐒𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐚𝐩𝐨𝐫𝐞, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐇𝐮𝐧𝐠𝐚𝐫𝐲, we deliver tailored solutions that drive efficiency, scalability, and growth.

We are offering the latest software & IT services to our customers! Contact us at info@teliolabs.com to know more. 

Visit our website: https://www.teliolabs.com/

Teliolabs Communications is an IT Services and IT Consulting firm established in 2020 and headquartered in South San Francisco, with a UK presence and distributed teams across India, UAE, UK, and the US. The company focuses on AI-driven IT and digital transformation, offering strategy, consulting, digital solutions, technology, and operations to drive efficiency, scalability, and growth.

Key details:
- Industry: IT Services and IT Consulting; Privately Held
- Headquarters: South San Francisco, CA, USA
- Global presence: United Kingdom, United States, India, Singapore, Hungary
- Employees: ~140 (notable YoY growth)
- Leadership: 
  - Amit Singh — Founder & Managing Director
  - Prashant Singh — Director of Business Development
  - Ranjitha M — Accounts Director
  - Vijay Babu Boyina — Vice President Finance
  - Abha Singh — Director
  - Dileep Kumar — Director

- Services and offerings:
  - AI-driven solutions and digital transformation
  - IT strategy, consulting, and digital solutions
  - Technology and operations support
  - Industry-focused, scalable solutions (across multiple sectors)
- Key capabilities: 
  - Tech stack includes ServiceNow, Docker, Kubernetes, Java, Python, React, SQL/NoSQL databases, microservices, ML/AI, data infrastructure, cloud, iot, and automation tools
  - Focus on modern software and IT services, cloud infrastructure, data & analytics, automation, and digital transformation
- Contact and engagement:
  - Website: teliolabs.com
  - Email: info@teliolabs.com
